recognize_zh: 這張多格組圖可以看到大量形態不一的原始細胞：有小而核質比高的 L1 樣、較大的 L2 樣、手鏡形（hand-mirror）與單核球樣原始細胞，加上含 Auer 小體的細胞、破碎的污跡細胞與標靶紅血球；形態混雜提示需要流式確認的混合表型急性白血病（MPAL）。
features: Heterogeneous blasts: small high N:C L1-like blasts, larger L2-like blasts and hand-mirror forms
Monocytoid blasts with folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm, some vacuolated or granular
Cell containing Auer rods (panel C, labelled 8) indicating myeloid differentiation
Large smudged/broken cells with fibrillar pink chromatin (Gumprecht-like shadows)
Target cells and a circulating nucleated red cell in the background; no sickle cells seen
Marrow panel F with dysplastic granulocytic precursors (pseudo-Pelger forms) among blasts
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (panels A–E) shows marked leukocytosis with numerous blasts of heterogeneous morphology, including small blasts with scant cytoplasm (L1-like), larger blasts with more cytoplasm (L2-like), hand-mirror forms and monocytoid blasts with folded nuclei and occasionally vacuolated or granular cytoplasm. A cell with Auer rods is present, and there are numerous large smudged cells with fibrillar nuclear material. The red cells include target cells and an occasional nucleated red cell; sickle cells are not identified. The bone marrow aspirate (panel F) shows blasts with dysplastic granulocytic forms. The heterogeneous blast morphology is not lineage-specific; with flow cytometry showing MPO plus T-lineage (cyCD3) and B-lineage (CD19, cyCD22, CD79a) antigens, findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia (B/T/myeloid).

ddx.vs: Auer rods and monocytoid blasts fit AML, but MPAL is defined only by flow showing coexisting cyCD3 and strong B-lineage antigens beyond aberrant expression.

ddx.dx: T-lymphoblastic leukemia with myeloid antigen expression
ddx.vs: T-ALL may express CD13/CD33/CD117 but lacks MPO and Auer rods and does not carry strong CD19 with cyCD22/CD79a.
ETP-ALL is cyCD3+, CD1a-/CD8-, with stem/myeloid markers but MPO negative, whereas this case is CD1a+ and MPO+.
CLL smudge cells occur among uniform mature small lymphocytes, not with blasts and Auer rods.
